summary: Replay store_fw_photons_at_chan's final numerical boundary: place Stark component wavelengths with their normalized intensities into the FIDA wavelength bins, applying the 1/(4*pi*dlambda) solid-angle/wavelength factor and dropping out-of-range components while retaining their raw bin indices for boundary audit.

identity.relation: dlambda = (lambdamax - lambdamin) / nlambda; bin = floor((lambda - lambdamin) / dlambda); a component inside the half-open interval [lambdamin, lambdamax) adds intensity / (4*pi*dlambda) to its bin (equivalent to the source's bin < 1 / bin > nlambda discard branches); accepted_component_count counts in-range components; intensity_factor_per_sr_nm is the constant 1/(4*pi*dlambda).
identity.direction: Stark component wavelengths + component intensities + wavelength window + bin count -> weight bins, zero-based raw bin indices, accepted component count, bin width and normalization factor
identity.definition: The saved FIDASIM FIDA权重谱线分箱 operator (source anchor src/fidasim.f90:12297-12347, store_fw_photons_at_chan): the terminal wavelength-bin boundary of the FIDA weight production. The operator computes no Doppler/Stark/Zeeman wavelengths and produces no photons -- the upstream component wavelengths come from the caller or from scirel.fusion.doppler-stark-zeeman-wavelengths; it accepts no weight or mean_f arrays.
identity.model: the saved formal implementation, ported verbatim with the registered boolean-entry hardening and the r80-v2 bin-width fail-closed repair
identity.geometry: one wavelength axis with uniform bins; no spatial geometry
identity.coordinates: wavelengths and window bounds in nm; intensities in photons*cm^-3 as carried by the caller; bins zero-based over nlambda; the factor unit is sr^-1 nm^-1
identity.boundary: component arrays of length exactly 3 or 15; finite wavelengths and finite nonnegative intensities; finite window with lambdamax > lambdamin; positive genuine integer nlambda; out-of-range components contribute nothing but keep their raw computed index; no writer, no answer-array input and no whole-program replay
assumptions: The intensities are the source's normalized Stark component spectrum carrier produced upstream by colrad; the operator does not validate their physical origin.
The half-open interval [lambdamin, lambdamax) is the source's own boundary convention.

inputs.name: wavelength_nm
inputs.description: The Stark component wavelengths in source component order.
inputs.constraints: Finite, length exactly 3 or 15; boolean entries rejected in both bool dtype and mixed object form (registered hardening).

inputs.name: component_intensity
inputs.description: The source spectrum intensities per Stark component.
inputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative, same length as wavelength_nm; boolean entries rejected (registered hardening).

inputs.name: lambdamin_nm
inputs.constraints: Finite and smaller than lambdamax_nm (booleans rejected -- registered hardening).

inputs.name: lambdamax_nm
inputs.constraints: Finite and larger than lambdamin_nm (booleans rejected -- registered hardening).

inputs.name: nlambda
inputs.description: The number of wavelength bins on the output axis.
inputs.constraints: A positive genuine integer (bools rejected, np.integer accepted).

outputs.name: weight_bins
outputs.description: The accumulated FIDA weight contribution per wavelength bin.
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; out-of-range components contribute nothing.

outputs.name: bin_index_zero_based
outputs.description: The raw zero-based bin index per component, including out-of-range values.
outputs.constraints: Finite integers retained for boundary audit; in-range values lie in [0, nlambda); a component whose raw index is not representable as a finite integer fails closed instead of reporting the int64 overflow sentinel (r80-v2 repair).

outputs.name: accepted_component_count
outputs.description: The number of components inside [lambdamin, lambdamax).

outputs.name: dlambda_nm
outputs.description: The uniform bin width (lambdamax - lambdamin) / nlambda.

preconditions: The caller supplies Stark component wavelengths and intensities produced by the same physical snapshot (colrad upstream).
supported: One store_fw_photons_at_chan binning boundary evaluation for one channel's wavelength axis.
excluded: Doppler/Stark/Zeeman wavelength production (see scirel.fusion.doppler-stark-zeeman-wavelengths), photon generation, colrad state advance, weight/mean_f inputs, multiple channels, instrument response and whole-program replay.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when the component arrays are not finite length-3/15 matching vectors, when intensities are negative or non-finite, when the window bounds are non-finite boolean or reversed, when nlambda is not a positive genuine integer, when the window width does not produce a positive finite bin width (r80-v2 repair: width underflow to zero raised ZeroDivisionError in the saved arm and width overflow to inf silently zeroed the factor), when the normalization factor 1/(4*pi*dlambda) is not strictly positive and finite -- a positive but subnormal width such as 1e-320 overflowed the factor and the weight bins to inf, and a window spanning 1e308 nm turned 4*pi*dlambda into inf and the factor into silent 0.0 (r80-v2 repairs), when a component wavelength's bin index is not representable as a finite integer (r80-v2 repair: the saved arm wrote the int64 overflow sentinel -9223372036854775808), or when the accumulated weight bins are not finite (r80-v2 repair: intensity*factor overflowed to inf despite a finite factor).
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Not applicable; bounded accumulation over finite inputs.

python.signature: bin_fida_los_components(*, wavelength_nm, component_intensity, lambdamin_nm, lambdamax_nm, nlambda)

example.description: The saved package's floor-binning and out-of-range drop probes.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.fusion import bin_fida_los_components
result = bin_fida_los_components(
    wavelength_nm=[650.0, 650.5, 651.999999],
    component_intensity=[1.0, 2.0, 3.0],
    lambdamin_nm=650.0, lambdamax_nm=652.0, nlambda=4)
assert result['bin_index_zero_based'].tolist() == [0, 1, 3]
assert result['accepted_component_count'] == 3
assert np.sum(result['weight_bins']) == float(6.0 / (4.0 * np.pi * 0.5))
dropped = bin_fida_los_components(
    wavelength_nm=[649.0, 650.25, 653.0],
    component_intensity=[1.0, 2.0, 4.0],
    lambdamin_nm=650.0, lambdamax_nm=652.0, nlambda=2)
assert dropped['accepted_component_count'] == 1
assert dropped['bin_index_zero_based'].tolist() == [-1, 0, 3]
try:
    bin_fida_los_components(
        wavelength_nm=np.asarray([True, 1.0, 1.0], dtype=object),
        component_intensity=[1.0, 1.0, 1.0],
        lambdamin_nm=650.0, lambdamax_nm=652.0, nlambda=4)
except ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('boolean entries must be rejected (registered hardening)')
example.expected: The saved probes reproduce, the raw out-of-range indices are retained, and the boolean-entry array raises ValueError per the registered hardening.

scope: Saved-package oracles: source floor binning with the conservation factor, out-of-range drop with retained raw indices, and the malformed fail-closed contracts.

Registered hardening: wavelength and intensity inputs reject boolean entries in both bool dtype and mixed object form such as np.asarray([True, 1.0], dtype=object) (the saved arm's np.asarray(..., dtype=float) silently coerced True to 1.0); boolean window bounds rejected; the saved arm's nlambda genuine-integer contract kept and pinned.

r80-v2 repairs: a window whose width underflows to zero (e.g. lambdamin=0, lambdamax=5e-324, nlambda=2) raises the declared ValueError instead of ZeroDivisionError, and a window whose width overflows to inf (e.g. +-1e308 bounds) fails closed instead of silently producing a zero normalization factor; a positive but subnormal width such as 1e-320 with nlambda=1 fails closed before the factor overflows to inf (the second review reproduction returned intensity_factor_per_sr_nm=inf and weight_bins=[inf]); a window spanning 1e308 nm fails closed because 4*pi*dlambda overflows and the factor becomes silent 0.0 (the third review reproduction); an intensity*factor product overflowing the accumulation to inf weight bins fails closed (the third review reproduction: intensity 1e20 with a finite factor ~7.96e299); a component whose bin index is not representable (e.g. wavelength 1e308) fails closed instead of reporting the int64 sentinel -9223372036854775808, while large-but-representable out-of-range indices are still kept raw.
Source relation pins: the upper window edge is exclusive (a component at lambdamax maps to discarded bin nlambda), and the accepted bins conserve the total intensity / (4*pi*dlambda).
